channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Is AI a threat to much-loved animation company Pixar?
item.description: If you've ever wished you could just live in the magical world of Toy Story and Monsters Inc - well, now you can as Pixar brings its immersive exhibition to London.

item.title: Zelenskyy praises disqualified Ukrainian Olympian for helmet honouring war dead
item.description: The Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy has awarded the Order of Freedom to the country's skeleton athlete Vladyslav Heraskevych after he was banned from competing in the Winter Olympics.

item.title: Sources tell Channel 4 News allegations against Dame Antonia were not dismissed
item.description: Following days of political turmoil and speculation - Sir Chris Wormald is standing down as the head of the Civil Service - after just over a year in the post.

item.title: ‘Largest action to increase pollution in US history’ says former US government official
item.description: President Trump has effectively scrapped the legal basis for regulating greenhouse gas emissions in the US.

item.title: Starmer’s future in the balance in crucial greater Manchester by-election
item.description: The future of the Government and Sir Keir Starmer himself could depend on what voters decide in a by-election in Greater Manchester later this month.

item.title: UK economy grew by ‘disappointing’ 0.1% at end of 2025
item.description: The UK economy grew by just 0.1% in the last quarter of 2025 - less than expected.

item.title: Cuba oil blockade ‘extreme form of unilateral economic coercion’ – UN co-ordinator
item.description: We spoke to Francisco Pichon, the UN's Resident Coordinator in Cuba, and asked him how bad the situation was on the ground in Cuba.

item.title: Cuba receives humanitarian aid from Mexico as Trump’s blockade bites
item.description: Humanitarian aid from Mexico has arrived in Havana, as Cuba continues to struggle under what amounts to a fuel blockade by the Trump administration.

item.title: Epstein Files: Investigation suggests just 2% of data released to public
item.description: Analysis by Channel 4 News has identified emails within the latest Epstein files that suggest that the mountain of information released by the US Department of Justice could amount to just a fraction of the total - potentially just 2% of the information that the FBI retrieved from Epstein's homes.

item.title: Ex-DoJ lawyer says ‘ill motivations at play’ over Epstein files release
item.description: Liz Oyer spent three years as a senior lawyer in the US Justice Department. We spoke to her about Channel 4 News' findings.
